correctness.rationale: Direct pseudoinverse reconstruction from the killed Poisson equation gives a closed two-by-two positive flux balance; the derived lifetime is exact for all finite connected vertex-transitive graphs. Independent direct solves check representative graph families.

originality.rationale: The full-text Beveridge source establishes single-target Green/hitting identities and pseudoinverse formulas but not the exact two partially reactive targets plus universal budget/placement optimum; single-perfect-trap and conductance-design papers similarly do not imply it directly. The related site-started cycle result yields an unequal allocation and does not entail the asserted uniform-start general graph theorem. Earlier general multiple-target formulas remain a priority risk.
residual_risks: An uninspected older multi-target Green/resolvent formula could yield the closed lifetime and joint optimum as a corollary.

value.rationale: A uniform-start two-reactive-site design law holds on every connected vertex-transitive graph, jointly optimizing allocation and locations for every total reaction budget. The 3×3 torus yields a strict lifetime improvement of 1/4 time unit at every budget when choosing diagonal rather than adjacent sites. It gives a physically interpretable effective-resistance design parameter.
